subject: infoschema: add btree index for reference foreign key (#59422)
summary: Reviewed this commit vs its first parent. It adds an MVCC-versioned btree index (`Data.referredForeignKeys`) and plumbing (`infoschemaV2.GetTableReferredForeignKeys`, builder add/drop/reset/GC) to speed up lookups of tables that reference a given parent via foreign keys. No remaining Blocker/High issues after checking later history on upstream/master.
